en.headline: First six batches of key enterprises invest HK$28.3 billion
en.dek: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said actual investment by the first six batches reached HK$28.3 billion by end-September, exceeding phased targets, with 142 firms now in total.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the first six batches of strategic enterprises brought to Hong Kong by the Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises had invested HK$28.3 billion by the end of September.

Writing in his weekly blog, Chan noted that these firms had also hired more than 10,300 people, exceeding the original phased targets by 30 per cent and 34 per cent respectively. Including a seventh batch of 18 enterprises recently welcomed, the total stands at 142 strategic firms that have set up or expanded in the city.

The enterprises are expected to bring about HK$84 billion in investment and create roughly 27,000 jobs over the coming years. Among the first six batches, about 70 per cent have established global or regional headquarters in Hong Kong and nearly 90 per cent have set up research-and-development centres, according to Chan.

zh.headline: 首六批重點企業實際投資達283億元
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波表示，截至九月底首六批重點企業實際投資達283億港元、聘用逾1.03萬人，超階段目標；連同第七批合計142家。
body: 財政司司長陳茂波表示，引進重點企業辦公室引進的首六批重點企業，截至九月底實際投資已達283億港元。
陳茂波在網誌中指出，這些企業亦聘用超過10,300人，分別較原階段目標高出三成及三成四。連同最近迎來的第七批18家企業，累計已有142家重點企業在港設立或擴展業務。
預計未來數年帶來約840億港元投資及約2.7萬個職位。首六批中約七成設全球或區域總部，近九成設研發中心。
